identity_guard: Commander-first: five-mana Abaddon gets cascade on your turn only for hand-cast spells with mana value at most opponents' life lost this turn. Keep threshold enablers, exile-cast payoffs, affordable protection and fast mana.
controls: all specific proposed cuts retained as controls
review at least one alternate non-core cut per add

model_requirements: Verify current Oracle, legal activation timing and self-damage, including removal in response
Model first turn on which tapped activated ability can be used with and without haste
Compare 40 and odd-life opponents with Solphim present/removed; keep self-damage separate
Verify Bloodletter of Aclazotz interaction and damage/life-loss accounting, including prevention
Quantify lost Birgi or Kessig same-turn pings/mana versus retained-baseline alternate cuts
Stress-test removal and protection, commander tax, and multiplayer opponent availability
Verify exchange of target life with current toughness counts non-damage life loss under current rules
Test high and low life total targets, Tree toughness modifications and legal target constraints
Model summoning sickness/haste and need to survive until an activation opportunity
Test hand-cast follow-through after activation in current turn with protection/mana available
Compare per-opponent life loss and Kessig repeatable tablewide early threshold
Evaluate alternate non-core cuts rather than assuming Birgi or Kessig is expendable
Trace exact Underworld Breach + Grinding Station + available artifact package with all recasts, sacrifices, untaps, zone changes and graveyard escape costs
Identify actual win condition and line interruption points, not just increased mill/storm proxy
Check that proposed line is executable from accepted 100-card baseline; distinguish a new variant from complete combo
Model Chrome Mox fast-mana opportunity cost and colored-source readiness for Abaddon
Compare with non-core alternate cut and preserve distinct commander-cascade gameplan
Use official attack-trigger rule: only original declared attacking makes copies, each token enters attacking and is not declared an attacker
Model connection rates versus blockers, removal and pillowfort, rather than assuming all three players are hit
Check first eligible attack turn, postcombat-only X window, mana left for hand-cast spells and Abaddon
Compare losing Birgi mana/draw or Kessig precombat repeatable threshold at Bracket 4
Resolve whether existing deck has enough combat support to justify a new package

required_before_determination: independent current Oracle and Commander legality check
interaction and combo lines checked against current Comprehensive Rules
bounded Phase-B test evidence with active effect modeling and registered seeds
full colored-mana and curve tradeoff against original list
commander marginal-value analysis and opponent/interaction red-team cases
named agent judgment that reviews alternatives and weaknesses
verified final 100-card/hash proof only if any proposal advances
explicit user approval before changing deck
